the harness enforces\nprogress with tools, sandbox, evals, and state.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSafety-first\u003c/strong\u003e: sandboxed shell, command policies, per-workspace\napprovals, adversarial regression tests.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBuilt for long runs\u003c/strong\u003e: durable session memory, spooled tool output,\nauto-compaction;
